original_test_intent: Collect Linux memory information and relevant DIMM/ECC evidence and compare it with the approved DIMM specification.
original_method: On the approved host, securely capture complete `/proc/meminfo`, free, NUMA/topology, Type17 DMI, relevant PCI context and full kernel memory/DIMM/ECC logs with checksums, then map fields to the specification.
manual_activity: User supplies the approved DIMM specification, host and evidence policy; agent can perform complete read-only Linux collection.
required_inputs: Approved Linux host identity and secure access
procfs, free, dmidecode, pciutils, NUMA and kernel-log privilege
Protected evidence storage and hardware-identifier policy
safety_requirements: Verify exact host before privileged reads
Use least privilege, managed authentication and host verification
Protect hardware identifiers and preserve full logs before filtering
Stop on wrong host, permission failure, ECC/memory error or instability
No memory/BIOS change, reboot or automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete meminfo/free/NUMA/Type17/PCI/kernel evidence with checksums/status
Produce expected-versus-observed DIMM/memory comparison without verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete and unsafe: omits source meminfo, relies on weak PCI/device-name signals, truncates logs and bypasses SSH protections.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely collect full meminfo, free, NUMA/topology, Type17 DMI, relevant PCI output and untruncated journal/dmesg memory/ECC records.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Atomically capture allocator, firmware-inventory, topology and kernel-health views, preserve raw evidence, then correlate fields to the signed DIMM spec.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds source-command fidelity, authoritative identity, complete logs, secure access and traceability.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: None; lspci or `/dev` names and forty log lines cannot replace meminfo plus complete DIMM evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Meminfo describes aggregate kernel accounting rather than per-DIMM identity; DMI and kernel logs may be incomplete or firmware-dependent.

project_override_considerations: Project must define installed-versus-usable accounting and authoritative slot/part fields; missing firmware data is reported, never fabricated.
expected_evidence: Host/date, OS/kernel, board/CPU/BIOS/firmware and tool versions
Complete Type17 records and relevant lspci context
Raw checksums, exit status and expected-versus-observed comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criteria consistently require Linux memory evidence versus DIMM specification. DeepSeek's weak substitutions are prior-review defects, not Master conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Host, tools, privilege and specification can be supplied; collection is read-only and automatable.

review_improvement: Restores `/proc/meminfo`, eliminates truncated/weak substitutes and makes the multi-source DIMM comparison auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Linux aggregate memory accounting, firmware slot inventory and kernel ECC history answer different questions. Meminfo cannot identify a DIMM, lspci normally enumerates controllers rather than modules, and device names do not prove population. A reliable comparison correlates complete Type17 identity/topology with allocator totals and untruncated health logs.
